Identifies fragment-only links as anchor type

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(nil)
url = 'https://example.com'
result = Crawlberg.scrape(engine, url)
puts result.links[0].link_type.inspect
```
